Name: Mew
Author: 00Strange00
Description:
Replaces the Cat with a certain pokemon, because we can't have enough of those.

Credit to Solink who ripped the sprites from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon. All I did was edit a few things to get the sprites to work right for this game. Mew is owned by Nintendo, etc etc.

[b]WARNING: [/b]
In order to change the face in the player's inventory I had to edit cursors.xnb, which has a ton of other little images that may be used by other mods. Using the cursors.xnb within this mod will overwrite any others. If you don't want this to happen, then only copy over cat.xnb

[b]To Install:[/b]
Copy the Contents folder located in the zip file and paste it into your main Stardew Valley folder. Remember to back up your original files beforehand.
